The '''Bala D'ur''' was a [[Gen'Dai/Legends|Gen'Dai]] faction of the [[White Maw]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] gang during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the [[Galactic War]]. The Gen'Dai held several [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolans]] [[Colonist/Legends|colonists]] hostage until they were rescued by forces affiliated with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Humanitarian Aid" />
